newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.

text.p: Profile of the winner of Saturday's men's World Cup downhill:
Previous World Cup victories: Five (all downhills) - Cortina
1990, Are 1990, Wengen 1995, Whistler Mountain 1995, Val Gardena
Other facts: By winning in Chamonix, he became the most

successful downhiller in Italian ski history with one more win than compatriot Herbert Plank, who won five downhills between 1974 and 1980. Ghedina's career almost ended in tragedy in 1991 when he spent two days in a coma after a car crash.
